# Cage

> Cage is a local and remote isolated development workbench. External agents can help users download, install, configure and diagnose it through the versioned JSON CLI.

- [Agent guide](https://lee-xeo.github.io/Claude-Cage/agent.md): Read this first. Installation paths, protocol discovery, JSON input, tasks, recovery and user authorization boundaries.
- [Full agent guide](https://lee-xeo.github.io/Claude-Cage/llms-full.txt): Plain-text copy of the same source.
- [User guide](https://lee-xeo.github.io/Claude-Cage/docs/agent/): Rendered guide.
- [Download helper](https://lee-xeo.github.io/Claude-Cage/agent-bootstrap.mjs): Node.js 20+, public release discovery and verified package download. Returns an installation plan; does not install.
- [Releases](https://github.com/Lee-xeo/Claude-Cage/releases): Published packages and platform-specific validation limits.

Discover installed capabilities before changing anything: <installed CLI> agent capabilities
Current source documentation may describe features absent from published releases.
The CLI targets the local workload at config_path. For a remote server, run it through authorized SSH on that server.
Preserve existing profile data, accounts, projects and VM disks. Never disable network isolation or system security checks to complete setup.
